title: App Store & Google Play app data input

mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Keyword ranks: where apps rank in App Store search for your keywords. Top charts: top free / paid / grossing apps on the App Store and Google Play. App details: full metadata for the apps you list.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword ranks mode: App Store search terms. Each result is one row with its rank (1 = top) and the app's metadata. App Store only: Google Play search isn't supported.

trackedApps.title: Only these apps
trackedApps.description: Optional. Keyword ranks mode: output only these App Store apps (URL, id123... or apple:bundle.id) for each keyword, plus a "notRanked" row when an app isn't in the top results. Pays for your apps only, not the whole result list.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Top charts mode: which charts to fetch for each store.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Top charts mode: App Store, Google Play or both.

category.title: Category
category.description: Top charts mode: chart category. "All" is the overall App Store chart, and the all-apps (non-game) chart on Google Play.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App details mode: App Store or Google Play URLs or IDs, store detected automatically: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id324684580, id324684580 = App Store; https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music or com.spotify.music = Google Play. Prefix apple: for an iOS bundle ID (apple:com.spotify.client).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de, fr, jp, br, in, ...). Ranks, charts, prices and availability are per country.

language.title: Language (Google Play)
language.description: Two-letter language code (en, de, es, ...) for Google Play names and descriptions. App Store text comes in the country's default language.

maxResults.title: Max ranks per keyword / chart
maxResults.description: How deep to go: top N results per keyword or chart. App Store search returns up to 200, App Store charts up to 100, Google Play charts up to 200. Each row is billed as one rank row.

rankChangesOnly.title: Rank changes only (monitoring)
rankChangesOnly.description: Keyword ranks and top charts: output only apps whose rank changed since the last run with the same input (up, down, new, dropped), with the previous rank. The first run outputs everything as a baseline. Schedule it daily for rank alerts. State is kept in the key-value store "app-store-apps-ranks" in your account.

minRankChange.title: Min rank change
minRankChange.description: Rank changes only: ignore moves smaller than this many places, including slides just across the top-N cut-off. Apple's search order jitters by a place or two between calls, so 3 is a good value for keyword alerts.
